shell.noProviderBanner: Add a provider key to start generating

providersModal.title: Providers
providersModal.subtitle: Bring your own keys. Models appear as soon as a provider that serves them is set up.
providersModal.privacy: Keys stay in this browser. Each request sends only the key it needs to this site's server, which forwards it to the provider and never stores or logs it.
providersModal.localHint: Local engines are called straight from your browser. Chrome may ask to allow local network access the first time.
providersModal.chatModelHint: Used by Agents, Vibe Motion, Workflows and Design Agent. Leave empty for the default.
providersModal.balanceNeedsAdmin: fal shows the balance only to admin keys
providersModal.checkpointsError: Could not reach ComfyUI. Start it with --enable-cors-header and check the URL.
providersModal.customWorkflowHint: Paste a ComfyUI workflow exported with "Save (API Format)". Use {{prompt}}, {{negative_prompt}}, {{seed}}, {{width}} and {{height}} as placeholders.
providersModal.orderHint: When several providers serve the same model, the highest one with a key is used.

localSetup.testNoModel: Connected, but no model is loaded yet (state: {state}). Load one in the server's web UI.
localSetup.testFailedComfy: Couldn't reach ComfyUI. Check it is running, started with --enable-cors-header {origin}, and that the browser may access your local network.
localSetup.testFailedSd: Couldn't reach the server. Check it is running on this address and that the browser may access your local network.

steps.comfyInstall: Install ComfyUI: the desktop app is easiest, or install it with Python:
steps.comfyModel: Put at least one checkpoint (.safetensors), for example SDXL or SD 1.5, in ComfyUI/models/checkpoints.
steps.comfyStart: Start it so this page may call it. In the desktop app, set the same CORS origin ({origin}) in its server settings.
steps.sdDownload: Download sd-server for your computer (Metal for Apple Silicon, CUDA for NVIDIA, Vulkan otherwise):
steps.sdModel: Download a model into a models folder, for example Stable Diffusion 1.5:
steps.sdStart: Start the server, then pick the model in its web UI at {url}. It allows browser requests by default.
steps.connect: Use the address above ({url} by default) and press Test connection.

providersModal.balanceUnavailable: {provider} doesn't report a balance for API keys. Check your usage on their dashboard.
providersModal.spendHint: Spend is counted in this browser from each run's price quote, or the provider's reported charge when it sends one. Your provider's bill is what counts.
providersModal.spendResetConfirm: Clear the spend counters in this browser?
